title: Effective quasi-coherent module descent with face maps
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $Z$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $u:U_\bullet\to Z$ be an augmented simplicial algebraic space such that $U_0\to Z$ and every map from $U_n$ to its matching object are flat, locally finitely presented and surjective; the degree-$n$ matching object is the finite limit of the compatible proper faces over $Z$. Restrict to injective order-preserving maps $[m]\hookrightarrow[n]$ and use the enlarged small etale ringed sites of algebraic-space objects [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model], with fibre-product transition functors and their canonical ring maps. Let $\mathscr M$ and $u$ be the resulting ringed total module category and augmentation [lem-sfb-semisimplicial-ringed-total-category]. A module in $\mathscr M$ is in $\mathcal A$ if all its components are quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and all its transitions $h^*F_m\to F_n$ are isomorphisms. The tensor pullback $u^*$ restricts to an equivalence $\operatorname{QCoh}(Z)\simeq\mathcal A$, with quasi-inverse the ordinary module direct image $u_*$. The restricted adjunction unit and counit are isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 0DHD, lemma-descent-qcoh-for-fppf-hypercovering: injective-order-map adaptation. The source treats all simplicial maps; the face-only assertion is agent-supplied and must be proved without assuming flat degeneracies.

proof.text: Write $q_n:U_n\to Z$, $v_i:U_n\to U_0$ for the vertices, and $c_\alpha:f_\alpha^*F_m\xrightarrow{\sim}F_n$ for the transitions of $F\in\mathcal A$. Pullback preserves quasi-coherence, so $u^*$ takes $\operatorname{QCoh}(Z)$ into $\mathcal A$. Put $R=U_0\times_ZU_0$ and $r=(v_0,v_1):U_1\to R$. This is the first matching cover. On $U_1$ put $t=c_{v_1}^{-1}c_{v_0}:v_0^*F_0\to v_1^*F_0$. On $U_2$ transition composition gives $t_{02}=t_{12}t_{01}$: each $t_{ij}$ equals $c_{v_j}^{-1}c_{v_i}$ after transport through $F_2$, and the middle factors cancel. Let $e=s_0:U_0\to U_1$. Pulling this equation along $s_0s_0:U_0\to U_2$ gives $(e^*t)^2=e^*t$. Since $e^*t$ is invertible, $e^*t=1$. Here degeneracies are only morphisms along which equations are pulled back; they are not transitions of $F$, and need not be flat.

source.place: Tag 0DHD, face-only adaptation: construct the edge transition; simplicial identities and cancellation

proof.text: Let $D=U_1\times_RU_1$, with universal edges $a,b$ from $x$ to $y$. Its boundary with vertices $(x,y,y)$ and edges $(a,b,e(y))$ defines a map $D\to M_2$, the degree-two matching object. Thus $W=D\times_{M_2}U_2\to D$ is fppf. Step 1's triangle equation on $W$ says $t_b=t_{e(y)}t_a=t_a$. Uniqueness of descended module maps makes the two pullbacks of $t$ equal on $D$: apply full faithfulness for the cover $W\to D$ to the two maps between the pulled-back vertex modules. Full faithfulness for $r:U_1\to R$ now descends $t$ uniquely to $\theta:\operatorname{pr}_0^*F_0\to\operatorname{pr}_1^*F_0$. Descend $t^{-1}$ too; uniqueness applied to the composites makes $\theta$ invertible. All modules in these applications are quasi-coherent by pullback preservation. No global lift of a boundary is chosen.

source.place: Tag 0DHD, face-only adaptation: compare parallel edges using a degenerate third edge and the matching cover

proof.text: Put $T=U_0\times_ZU_0\times_ZU_0$. The matching object $M_2\to T$ is the fibre product of the three base changes of $r:U_1\to R$, one for each edge; hence it is fppf, by repeated base change and composition. Therefore $U_2\to T$ is fppf. Pulling $\theta_{02}$ and $\theta_{12}\theta_{01}$ to $U_2$ gives exactly the equality of Step 1. Full faithfulness for this cover makes them equal on $T$. Thus $(F_0,\theta)$ is a descent datum for $q_0:U_0\to Z$. Effective descent gives $G\in\operatorname{QCoh}(Z)$ and an isomorphism $b_0:q_0^*G\xrightarrow{\sim}F_0$ inducing $\theta$. This uses a cover of the triple product, not an assertion that every compatible boundary has a global filler.

source.place: Tag 0DHD, face-only adaptation: descend the triangle equation, then apply Tag 04W8

proof.text: For $n\geq0$ define $b_n:q_n^*G\to F_n$ by $c_{v_i}\circ v_i^*b_0$, using any vertex $i$. For $i<j$, pull $\theta$ back along the edge $U_n\to U_1$ determined by $\{i,j\}$. The defining descent identity for $b_0$ and $t_{ij}=c_{v_j}^{-1}c_{v_i}$ make the two formulas equal. They are therefore independent of $i$. For $\alpha:[m]\hookrightarrow[n]$, choose vertex $i$ in $[m]$; transition composition gives $c_\alpha f_\alpha^*b_m=c_{v_{\alpha(i)}}v_{\alpha(i)}^*b_0=b_n$. Thus $b:u^*G\xrightarrow{\sim}F$ is an isomorphism of systems. A map between two such systems is determined by its degree-zero map, since every $c_{v_i}$ is invertible. Its degree-one compatibility is precisely compatibility with $\theta$. Conversely that compatibility and the same vertex formula give every higher square. Full faithfulness of ordinary descent for $q_0$ now proves full faithfulness of $u^*$ on quasi-coherent modules.

source.place: Tag 0DHD, face-only adaptation: vertex assembly and compatible morphisms

proof.text: Identify the ordinary right adjoint, including its values in the ambient module category. For any system $F$ put $K=\operatorname{Eq}(q_{0,*}F_0\rightrightarrows q_{1,*}F_1)$, where the arrows come from the two vertex transitions. By component module adjunction, a map $N\to K$ is a map $q_0^*N\to F_0$ whose two induced maps $q_1^*N\to F_1$ agree. Define its degree-$n$ map by any vertex. Every pair of vertices bounds an edge, so the degree-one equality makes this independent of the vertex; composition then gives compatibility with every injection. Conversely a map of systems has these properties. These mutually inverse constructions are natural for every module $N$, so $K\simeq u_*F$ by the right-adjoint universal property. In the enlarged model its sections over etale $V\to Z$ are the equalizer of the two maps $F_0(U_0\times_ZV)\rightrightarrows F_1(U_1\times_ZV)$, with scalar action from $\mathcal O_Z(V)$.

source.place: Tag 0D70, lemma-augmentation-site, compatible-family proof repeated for injective maps and module adjunction

proof.text: For the $G$ of Step 3, use $b_0,b_1$ in Step 5. The condition on a section of $q_0^*G$ is agreement of its two pulls on $U_1\times_ZV$. Faithfulness of descent for the base change of $r$ makes this equivalent to agreement on $R\times_ZV$. Full faithfulness for the cover $U_0\times_ZV\to V$, applied to maps from $\mathcal O_V$ to $G|_V$, identifies this equalizer with $G(V)$. A section is a map from the structure module: send $1$ to the section, with inverse $s\mapsto(a\mapsto as)$ on each restriction. These identifications respect restrictions and scalars, so $u_*F\simeq G$ is quasi-coherent. For $F=u^*G$ the identification of $G\to u_*u^*G$ is exactly restriction of sections, hence the adjunction unit. It is invertible. The triangle identity $\epsilon_{u^*G}\circ u^*\eta_G=1$ makes the counit invertible on $u^*G$; naturality and Step 4's isomorphism give it on every $F\in\mathcal A$. This proves both the claimed quasi-inverse and the restricted adjunction assertion.

source.place: Tag 0DHD, final quasi-inverse argument; here the compatible-section equalizer also identifies the actual unit

Adds one strictly smaller ordinary fppf-descent prerequisite; retains the statement and all prior search records.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N5-e784b3ce8 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item's 6 steps, the new node lem-sfb-space-fppf-qcoh-descent, every cited statement, and Stacks 0DHD (spaces-simplicial l.7327), 04W8 (spaces-descent l.208) and 0DFQ. Step 1: degeneracies are used only to pull back equations; s_0s_0 composed with each edge is s_0, so (e^*t)^2=e^*t and hence e^*t=1. Step 2: the boundary (x,y,y; a,b,s_0y) is a compatible point of M_2; W→D is fppf by covering calculus (2); t descends along r:U_1→R=M_1. Step 3: M_2 is the fibre product over T of the three base changes of r, so U_2→T is fppf and the cocycle descends. Step 4: the vertex formula assembles b and gives full faithfulness. Step 5: the equalizer K represents Hom(u^*N,F) for every N, so it is the actual u_*. Step 6: section descent identifies u_*F with G and the unit with restriction of sections; the triangle identity gives the counit. The new node is a faithful fppf specialization of 04W8 with no finiteness hypotheses, strictly smaller than the item. I found no duplicate: lem-pc-fpqc-descent and picard-descent are for schemes only, and the blueprint search found nothing. It is not a Mathlib leaf. Batch-5: def-trf-algebraic-space, def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module and def-trf-space-etale-module-functors are general definitions; pullback-quasicoherent and covering-calculus reach sec-trace-formula only through the algebraic-space definition. None is a trace-formula or Poincaré step, so I accept them. Tool uses accepted: ringed-topoi-module-adjunction (generic adjunction) and the enlarged étale site model (already a stmt_dep). No fixes.
